pageTitle: BookmarkPet — A little note for your next step
metaDescription: Leave a note before you close your Mac. A tiny macOS menu bar companion that remembers your next step. Free and open source.
heroDescription: A little note before you close your Mac.
desktopCaption: A bookmark for your next session.
demoDisclaimer: Demo resets on reload. The app UI is currently in Korean.
noScript: Enable JavaScript to try the demo.
step2Body: It stays when you close the app.
step3Body: Click the pet when you return.
install2: Move BookmarkPet.app into your Applications folder and open it.
install3: Find the bookmark pet in your menu bar and click it.
installWarning: This preview has no Developer ID signature or Apple notarization. macOS may block it. If you trust the download, try opening it once, then check System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway. Managed Macs may not allow this.
storageBody: In a plain text file on your Mac. No account or cloud transfer. The file is not encrypted by BookmarkPet and remains after you delete the app.
undoBody: Use the ☰ menu to clear the note or undo the latest clear. Clear undo is available until your next edit or app exit.
loginBody: Keep the app in your Applications folder, then turn on 로그인 시 실행 (Launch at login) in the ☰ menu. The menu explains when system approval is needed.
loginLimitation: Actual reboot/login, Intel Mac, and macOS 13 execution have not yet been verified.
websitePrivacyQuestion: What happens to my demo note?
websitePrivacyBody: It stays only in this page’s memory. It is not sent to a server or saved in browser storage. Reloading or switching languages resets it. This website uses no analytics or advertising tools.
hostingPrivacy: GitHub Pages, our hosting provider, may log visitor IP addresses for security.
footerTagline: A little note for your next step.
